note: Concise English paraphrases of official Yeeflow Help Center articles. Read entries through scripts/knowledge.mjs; each entry links to its authoritative article.

entries.name: Dashboard designer

entries.name: Approval form designer
entries.summary: Design submission, task, and print pages and bind their controls to approval variables.

entries.name: How do I use global fonts and colors

entries.summary: Reuse global fonts and colors through style references rather than separate local values.

entries.name: Right Click and Copy / Paste Controls
aliases: Right Click and Copy / Paste Controls
entries.summary: Copy controls or styles, then check bindings and action targets in the destination context.

entries.name: Public form designer
entries.summary: Design public data collection and its submission feedback for the associated data list.

entries.name: List form designer
entries.summary: Design the forms used to create, edit, and view list records.

entries.name: Add Controls panel
entries.summary: Select controls available in the current designer; availability depends on the design context.

entries.name: Yeeflow canvas overview
entries.summary: Use the canvas to select, position, nest, and configure controls.

entries.name: Navigator
entries.summary: Use the control tree to locate nested controls and manage their order.

entries.name: Page Background and Content Area Styles
aliases: Page Background and Content Area Styles
entries.summary: Configure the page background and content area separately, including width and spacing.

entries.name: Thank you page & Redirect (Approval Form Only)
aliases: Thank you page & Redirect (Approval Form Only)
entries.summary: Configure a completion message or redirect for the applicable submission context.

entries.name: Default Control Styles for Appearance
entries.summary: Maintain reusable default control appearances at the supported global or application scope.

entries.name: Understanding form controls and the associated variables / fields
aliases: Understanding form controls and the associated variables / fields
entries.summary: Distinguish the visual control from its associated variable or list field and match their types.

entries.name: Title of field controls
entries.summary: Configure a field title independently of the underlying saved field name.

entries.name: Single line
entries.summary: Collect short plain text with a binding, length limits, validation, and change actions where supported.

entries.name: Multiple line
entries.summary: Collect multiline plain text; use a rich-text field when formatting must be saved.

entries.name: Rich Text
entries.summary: Collect and save formatted text; distinguish this from a display-only paragraph.

entries.name: Number
entries.summary: Collect numeric values with suitable precision, formatting, and range rules.

entries.name: Percent
entries.summary: Store a numeric fraction and display it as a percentage; keep formula and display conventions consistent.
entries.considerations: For example, a stored value of 0.75 is displayed as 75%. Do not substitute the displayed percentage for the underlying numeric convention.

entries.name: Currency
entries.summary: Present monetary values with currency formatting and precision; define calculations independently.

entries.name: Single select
entries.summary: Select one value from a configured option set.

entries.name: Multiple select
entries.summary: Select multiple values and use a field or variable that supports multiple values.

entries.name: Switch
entries.summary: Capture a Boolean value through an on/off switch.

entries.name: Date Picker
entries.summary: Collect a date or supported date-time value; verify display preferences and time-zone meaning.

entries.name: Date Range
entries.summary: Collect a start and end date as a range and validate their order.

entries.name: Time Picker
entries.summary: Collect a time value and distinguish time-of-day from a complete date-time.

entries.name: Hyperlink
entries.summary: Save a link and present suitable display text for opening it.

entries.name: Image
entries.summary: Upload and save an image field; use Picture for page imagery instead.

entries.name: Attachment
entries.summary: Upload attachments with appropriate count, size, file-type, and access settings.

entries.name: Calculation
entries.summary: Calculate a value from an expression and bind the result to the appropriate variable.

entries.name: SubList (Approval form only)
entries.summary: Collect repeated detail rows within an approval form, with row fields and operations.

entries.name: User
entries.summary: Select users or allowed identities and keep identity values distinct from display names.

entries.name: Lookup
entries.summary: Select related records using their item IDs; configure display fields, filters, sorting, and compatible field mappings.
entries.considerations: Separate the stored Item ID, display field, and business key. Configure additional-field mappings only between compatible field types. Check the documented filter and index restrictions.

entries.name: Lookup List
entries.summary: Select multiple source records and map them into rows of an associated List control in an approval form.
entries.considerations: This control adds selected source records to an associated List as rows. Its selected-item values are not a substitute for defining the target row mappings. Check its approval-form applicability.

entries.name: Rating
entries.summary: Collect ratings in approval forms; verify the associated variable type rather than inferring it from numeric appearance.
entries.considerations: The approval-form rating article describes a text attribute with a numeric presentation. Do not assume it has the same type as a data-list rating.

entries.name: Department
entries.summary: Select a department from the configured organization structure.

entries.name: Location
entries.summary: Select a configured location value.

entries.name: Cost Center
entries.summary: Select a cost center for business allocation.

entries.name: Metadata
entries.summary: Select one value from a maintained metadata category.

entries.name: Multiple Metadata
entries.summary: Select multiple values from a metadata category and use compatible multivalue bindings.

entries.name: Signature
entries.summary: Collect a signature within a form; distinguish it from an external electronic-signature workflow.

entries.name: Tags
entries.summary: Use tags to classify records and support retrieval.

entries.name: Rating (Data list only)
entries.summary: Use a data-list rating field to represent numeric scores with rating symbols.

entries.name: Section Overview
entries.summary: Organize related controls into sections with shared layout and presentation.

entries.name: Columns - Create, Edit and Style
entries.summary: Arrange section content in columns and verify behavior on narrower screens.

entries.name: Grid
entries.summary: Place controls in a grid with row, column, spacing, and span settings.

entries.name: Container Overview
entries.summary: Arrange child controls within a container using its layout and alignment options.

entries.name: Container-Execute type
entries.summary: Configure what a container click does, including actions, navigation, form opening, or collection-item operations.
entries.considerations: A container can execute an action, link, add-item operation, dashboard opening, or approval-form opening. Collection-item behavior requires a suitable collection context.

entries.name: Text
entries.summary: Display a heading or title without creating a saved business field.

entries.name: Paragraph
entries.summary: Present formatted page content; use Rich Text for user-entered formatted values.

entries.name: Picture
entries.summary: Display a page image from a configured source with suitable sizing.

entries.name: Divider
entries.summary: Separate page content with a styled divider.

entries.name: Spacer
entries.summary: Add deliberate whitespace between page elements.

entries.name: Button
entries.summary: Provide a clickable button whose behavior is configured independently of its appearance.

entries.name: Button-Execute type
entries.summary: Choose the button execution type, such as an action, link, form opening, or collection-item operation.
entries.considerations: Button execution type is distinct from button style. Check the selected action or target form and the parameters passed to it.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.summary: Organize content into tabs and check how hidden content interacts with values and validation.

entries.name: Toggle
entries.summary: Expand and collapse content; this does not represent a Boolean field value.

entries.name: Print Button (Approval form only)
entries.summary: Open an associated approval-form print page through a print button.

entries.name: Icon
entries.summary: Display an icon and configure supported appearance or interaction.

entries.name: Timer
entries.summary: Display a countdown and configure its expiry behavior; do not treat it as a persistent background scheduler.

entries.name: Table
entries.summary: Arrange controls in table cells for structured presentation or printing; use Data Table for querying records.

entries.name: Icon List
entries.summary: Present a list of items with icons, text, and supported links.

entries.name: Dropbar
entries.summary: Expose supplementary content through a compact dropbar interaction.

entries.name: Alert
entries.summary: Display an informational, success, warning, or danger message.

entries.name: Progress Bar
entries.summary: Display progress as a bar with an appropriately interpreted value.

entries.name: Progress Circle
entries.summary: Display progress or a measure as a circular indicator.

entries.name: Steps bar
entries.summary: Show steps and the current stage using a source supported in the current context.

entries.name: Barcode Control
entries.summary: Generate a barcode from a fixed value or variable; choose the format and presentation separately from scanning.

entries.name: QR Code
entries.summary: Generate and display a QR code for content or a link; scanning is a separate action.

entries.name: Comments (Available for Approval form and List form only)
aliases: Comments (Available for Approval form and List form only)
entries.summary: Enable record-related comments in supported approval and list form contexts.

entries.name: Custom Code Control
entries.summary: Extend a page with the official Custom Code capability when the task explicitly requires that extension.

entries.name: Embed Control
entries.summary: Embed external content subject to the source service's authentication and embedding restrictions.

entries.name: Document Embed
entries.summary: Preview an accessible document within the page; preview and download permissions are separate concerns.

entries.name: Submit Button (Public form only)
entries.summary: Provide the submission button and presentation for a public form.

entries.name: News
entries.summary: Present news or content records with configured fields, layout, and pagination.

entries.name: Gallery
entries.summary: Present images and record information in a gallery layout.

entries.name: Data Table
entries.summary: Query and display records using configured columns, filters, search, sorting, pagination, and permitted actions.

entries.name: Gantt Chart
entries.summary: Display scheduled activities using start and end dates; configure relationship fields for dependencies or parent tasks.

entries.name: Document Library
entries.summary: Display a document library and expose file operations permitted for the user.

entries.name: Collection
entries.summary: Repeat a custom item layout for source records and provide each item with its own data context.
entries.considerations: Design the repeated item layout before configuring its current-record actions. Check source-specific link behavior; not every report source supports the same item operations.

entries.name: Kanban board
entries.summary: Group records into board columns and verify which editing operations the source and permissions support.

entries.name: Dynamic Series Controls
entries.summary: Use dynamic controls inside an appropriate record context to display that record's values.

entries.name: Dynamic Field
entries.summary: Display a selected field from the current collection record.

entries.name: Dynamic User
entries.summary: Display user information associated with the current collection record.

entries.name: Dynamic Image
entries.summary: Display an image field from the current collection record.

entries.name: Dynamic File
entries.summary: Display attachments from the current collection record with appropriate access.

entries.name: Horizontal timeline
entries.summary: Display dated records on a horizontal timeline.

entries.name: Vertical timeline
entries.summary: Display dated records on a vertical timeline.

entries.name: Pie Chart
entries.summary: Compare category proportions using a category dimension and aggregated values.

entries.name: Column Chart
entries.summary: Compare measures across categories using columns and supported series settings.

entries.name: Line Chart
entries.summary: Show a measure's trend across ordered dates or categories.

entries.name: Gauge Chart
entries.summary: Show a measure relative to a configured gauge scale.

entries.name: Funnel Chart
entries.summary: Display measures across ordered stages in a funnel.

entries.name: Color Block Heat map
entries.summary: Represent a numeric distribution through colors across a matrix.

entries.name: Summary
entries.summary: Display a single aggregated measure, such as a count or sum, from a configured source.

entries.name: Pivot table
entries.summary: Aggregate measures across row and column dimensions in a pivot table.

entries.name: Applicant Info
entries.summary: Display system applicant information; distinguish the applicant from the current operator.

entries.name: Action Panel
entries.summary: Provide native submission or task operations according to the form and task context.
entries.considerations: Use the native panel operations for task decisions. Changing a business Status field alone does not approve or reject a workflow task.

entries.name: Workflow History
entries.summary: Display workflow processing history, participants, timestamps, and operation information.

entries.name: An Overview of Data Filter controls in Yeeflow
aliases: An Overview of Data Filter controls in Yeeflow
entries.summary: Collect filter variables and reference them in data queries so that they actually affect the displayed records.
entries.considerations: A filter control supplies values. Reference those values in the target data source conditions; adding a filter to a page does not automatically connect every data display.

entries.name: Understanding Apply type in Yeeflow Data Filter Controls
aliases: Understanding Apply type in Yeeflow Data Filter Controls
entries.summary: Choose between applying a filter immediately and applying it through an explicit Apply button.

entries.name: Search Filter
entries.summary: Collect a text search condition and configure the supported minimum search length.

entries.name: Select Filter
entries.summary: Provide a single-selection filter with configured choices and values.

entries.name: Checkbox Filter
entries.summary: Provide a multiple-selection filter using supported value types.

entries.name: Radio Filter
entries.summary: Provide mutually exclusive filter choices rather than saving a business answer.

entries.name: Range Filter
entries.summary: Collect a continuous numeric range for data filtering.

entries.name: Check Range
entries.summary: Filter records using predefined ranges with explicit boundaries.

entries.name: Date Filter
entries.summary: Collect a date range for source filtering rather than field input.

entries.name: Relative Period
entries.summary: Filter using a relative period such as a year, month, or week.

entries.name: Apply Button
entries.summary: Apply the associated filter values to the target data presentation.

entries.name: Remove Filters
entries.summary: Clear selected filters and restore the intended default query state.

entries.name: Hierarchy filter
entries.summary: Filter through a supported hierarchy such as departments, metadata, or parent-child records.

entries.name: Sorting filter
entries.summary: Let users select a supported sorting rule for displayed data.

entries.name: Dynamic Display Rules
entries.summary: Control conditional visibility or editing behavior without substituting for data access permissions.

entries.name: Dynamic Style
entries.summary: Change presentation according to conditions; avoid communicating essential meaning through color alone.

entries.name: Custom Validation
entries.summary: Define invalid conditions and actionable error messages for field validation.

entries.name: Advanced Settings Tab
entries.summary: Configure supported dimensions, spacing, responsiveness, and layout-related advanced settings.

entries.name: How to Use Z-Index in Designer
aliases: How to Use Z-Index in Designer
entries.summary: Control the visual stacking of overlapping elements without changing business execution order.

entries.name: Custom CSS
entries.summary: Use the official Custom CSS capability for styling within the authorized scope.

entries.name: Assigning CSS ID and CSS Classes to a control
aliases: Assigning CSS ID and CSS Classes to a control
entries.summary: Assign CSS IDs or classes for styling rather than treating them as field identifiers.

entries.name: CSS Grid fractional unit overview
entries.summary: Use fractional grid units to distribute remaining space proportionally.

entries.name: Advanced Control Settings: Container Child
entries.summary: Configure a flex-container child's alignment, order, and size in conjunction with the parent layout.

entries.name: Advanced Control Settings: Grid Child
entries.summary: Configure a grid child's position, span, and alignment within the parent grid.

entries.name: Advanced Control Settings: Order
entries.summary: Change the visual order of flex children without changing data or workflow sequence.

entries.name: Advanced Control Settings: Size
entries.summary: Configure growth and shrinking in flex layouts while checking explicit width interactions.

entries.name: Understanding Position Settings in Yeeflow
entries.summary: Choose static, relative, absolute, fixed, or sticky positioning and check the relevant container behavior.

entries.name: Understand Expression Editor
entries.summary: Build expressions using the variables, context, operators, and functions available in the current scenario.

entries.name: Using expression editor for data calculations
aliases: Using expression editor for data calculations
entries.summary: Calculate or compose values with expressions while handling types, empty values, and precision.

entries.name: Comparisons operators in Expression Editor
entries.summary: Use compatible types and explicit empty-value behavior when constructing comparison conditions.

entries.name: Using yeeflow predefined functions in expression editor
aliases: Using yeeflow predefined functions in expression editor
entries.summary: Choose predefined functions according to their documented scenarios, parameters, and return types.

entries.name: Form Actions
entries.summary: Group page actions into ordered steps and bind them to supported page or control events.

entries.name: Collection actions -View Item
entries.summary: Open a collection record in a read-only item view.

entries.name: Collection actions
entries.summary: Execute supported operations against the current or selected collection records.

entries.name: Execution Condition of actions
entries.summary: Evaluate a step's execution condition and separately decide whether to continue when it is not met.
entries.considerations: A condition not being met is different from an execution failure. Configure whether a failed condition should skip the step or stop the action.

entries.name: Collection actions -Edit item
entries.summary: Open the editing form for a collection record with the appropriate permissions.

entries.name: Collection actions -Delete item
entries.summary: Delete the intended collection record, with explicit scope and suitable confirmation.

entries.name: Collection actions- Update fields
entries.summary: Update selected fields on target collection records without replacing unrelated values.

entries.name: Collection actions -Trigger list workflows
entries.summary: Trigger a predefined list workflow for the intended collection records.

entries.name: Set Variables Step
entries.summary: Assign constants or expression results to page variables or fields; assignment alone is not persistence.
entries.considerations: Assignment changes the current values; identify the separate submission, save, or data-write operation if persistence is required.

entries.name: Show confirm dialog step
entries.summary: Ask a confirmation question and use the resulting value in subsequent decisions.

entries.name: Submit Form step
entries.summary: Submit, save, or process a task in a supported form context; this step is not available in dashboards.
entries.considerations: The documented step applies to supported list, approval, and public forms, not dashboards. Use an appropriate open-form or start-workflow operation for a dashboard task.

entries.name: Start Another Action step
entries.summary: Invoke another defined page action while checking context and avoiding circular invocation.

entries.name: Execute custom code step
entries.summary: Run an explicitly configured custom-script action when the task requires that official extension capability.

entries.name: Using the Set Variables Step to Change the Value of the Status Field
aliases: Using the Set Variables Step to Change the Value of the Status Field
entries.summary: Set a business Status field without assuming that the system workflow state changes with it.

entries.name: Set data list step
entries.summary: Add, conditionally update, or delete list records through a page action; define mappings and result handling.
entries.considerations: Specify add, update, or delete; target source; matching conditions; and field mappings. Define how later steps determine success using the supported configuration and verify it in the target environment.

entries.name: Query data step
entries.summary: Query a configured source using conditions, sorting, result mode, and compatible output mappings.
entries.considerations: Choose single or multiple results, filtering, sorting, paging, and output mappings. Define what the business needs for no matches or multiple matches, then confirm the current behavior rather than assuming automatic clearing or an all-pages count.

entries.name: Open item form step
entries.summary: Open an item form with the required operation mode, parameters, defaults, and presentation.

entries.name: Open dashboard step
entries.summary: Open a dashboard with query parameters and a supported opening mode.

entries.name: Start workflow step
entries.summary: Start an approval or list workflow from a page action and check the documented scope and execution requirements.

entries.name: HTTP request step
entries.summary: Call an external HTTP endpoint through a page action with request, authentication, response, and failure settings.

entries.name: Print page step (Form action)
entries.summary: Print applicable page content with the configured template and preview behavior.

entries.name: AI Assistant step (Form Action)
entries.summary: Call an AI assistant from a page action and map its output to suitable variables.

entries.name: Invoke Custom Service from a Form Action
aliases: Invoke Custom Service from a Form Action
entries.summary: Invoke a published custom service from a form action using its declared inputs and outputs.

entries.name: NFC reader Action step
entries.summary: Read an NFC tag through a supported page action, device, and runtime container.

entries.name: Barcode scan Action step
entries.summary: Scan a barcode or QR code through a supported page action and map the result.

aliases: Overview of the approval form designer

entries.name: Design the submission form
entries.summary: Design the initial submission page and bind its field controls to variables.

entries.name: Understand task forms
entries.summary: Use task forms for assignment or claim tasks and decide where forms can be reused.

entries.name: Design task forms
entries.summary: Design or copy task forms, then associate them with the correct workflow tasks.

entries.name: Design print page

entries.summary: Configure workflow start settings, notifications, and supported recall or termination behavior.

entries.name: Assignment Task Action
entries.summary: Assign approval or completion tasks using the configured participants and sequential or parallel rules.

entries.name: Add assignee with Assignee Editor
entries.summary: Choose assignees through users, managers, positions, groups, or compatible variables.

entries.name: Claim Task Action
entries.summary: Create a pool of tasks that eligible candidates can claim.

entries.name: Send Email Action
entries.summary: Compose workflow emails with recipients, subject, body, and context variables.

entries.name: Set Variable Action
entries.summary: Assign values to variables in the current or another supported approval form.

entries.name: Set Data List Action
entries.summary: Add, update, or delete list data through a background workflow action with explicit target conditions.

entries.name: Document Recognition Action
entries.summary: Recognize document content through the configured AI connection and map the results.

entries.name: Inclusive Gateway Action
entries.summary: Configure conditional branching and synchronization using an inclusive gateway.
entries.considerations: Use the documented gateway semantics when branches need synchronization. An ordinary connector must not be assumed to wait for every path.

entries.name: Query Data Action
entries.summary: Query lists, document libraries, or supported reports and map single or multiple results in a workflow.

entries.name: Start workflow Action
entries.summary: Start another approval or list workflow with the required identity and variable mappings.

entries.name: Delay Action
entries.summary: Wait for a duration, date, or supported condition, subject to the documented settings.

entries.name: End with Rejection Action
entries.summary: End a workflow as rejected and support permitted editing and resubmission; verify identifier behavior separately.
entries.considerations: Keep business references, form-record IDs, and workflow-instance IDs conceptually separate; confirm resubmission behavior for the actual form.

entries.name: End Action
entries.summary: End a workflow path and configure whether the whole process and other active branches should end.

entries.name: HTTP Request Action
entries.summary: Call an HTTP endpoint from a background workflow with configured authentication and result mappings.

entries.name: Adobe Sign action
entries.summary: Send documents for Adobe Sign signing through the required external connection.

entries.name: Signal Event Action
entries.summary: Handle supported cancellation or recall signals and configure the related follow-up actions.
entries.considerations: Verify the signal types and downstream actions. If event ordering or state visibility matters, establish that behavior in the target environment.

entries.name: Generate document action
entries.summary: Generate a document by mapping variables into a configured template.

entries.name: How to save sub list values to word template
aliases: How to save sub list values to word template

aliases: How to save workflow variables to word template

entries.name: Loop Action

entries.name: Respond to AI Action(Workflow)

entries.name: AI Assistant action(Workflow Action)
